{{short description|Polish mathematician and professor}}
{{use dmy dates|date=May 2023}}

'''Kazimierz Cwojdziński''' (born 8 January 1878 in [[Plewiska]] – died 12 August 1948 in [[Poznań]]) was a Polish mathematician and professor of the School of Engineering in Poznań.<ref name=Ewa>{{cite book|url=https://academiccommons.columbia.edu/doi/10.7916/d8-y9gr-n993/download|first=Ewa  |last= Dabkowska|title=Polish Mathematics Education Periodicals from 1930 to 1950|pages=124–125 |publisher=[[Columbia University]]|date=2019|doi=10.7916/d8-y9gr-n993 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title= Kim był urodzony w Plewiskach prof. Kazimierz Cwojdziński?  |website=Village of [[Plewiska]]|url= http://www.plewiska.net/?kim-byl-urodzony-w-plewiskach-prof.-kazimierz-cwojdzinski-,2474 }}</ref> Cwojdziński published his works regarding secondary school curriculum and school mathematics in the journals ''Wiadomości Matematyczne'', ''Muzeum'', ''Parametr'', and ''Matematyka'' as well as the German journal ''Archiv der Mathematik und Physik''.<ref name=Ewa/> He was among the first year-group to obtain a doctorate in mathematics from the [[Adam Mickiewicz University]].<ref>{{cite book |year=1971 |title=Matematyka, fizyka i chemia na Uniwersytecie Poznańskim |publisher=Wydawnictwo Naukowe Uniwersytetu im Adama Mickiewicza |page=5}}</ref>

During the Nazi occupation of Poland in [[World War II]] Cwojdziński was one of the most active teachers in clandestine schools in [[Greater Poland]].<ref>{{cite book |last=Michalski |first=Stanisław |year=1968 |title=Tajne nauczanie w Wielkopolsce w okresie okupacji hitlerowskiej |publisher=Wydawnictwo Poznańskie |page=88}}</ref>
